app.title: Minecraft Setup Manager
app.subtitle: Gets Minecraft ready for the server.

applicationUpdate.title: App updates
applicationUpdate.current: This app is up to date.
applicationUpdate.compactError: The app update check did not finish.
applicationUpdate.availableDetail: A newer application build is ready to review.
applicationUpdate.consent: Update from {{currentVersion}} to {{version}}? The app will download and install the update, then close and reopen.
applicationUpdate.signatureTrust: The application verifies the update with its embedded updater key before installation. This is separate from operating-system publisher signing, so a system trust warning may still appear.
applicationUpdate.setupBusy: Finish the current setup operation before updating the app.
applicationUpdate.installing: The download is complete. Verifying and installing the update...
applicationUpdate.restarting: The update is installed. Reopening the application...
applicationUpdate.readyDetail: The update is installed, but the application could not reopen automatically.
applicationUpdate.errorDetail: The update did not complete or could not be confirmed. You can keep using the application and try again.

official.label: Minecraft Launcher
official.detail: Best choice if you use the normal Minecraft app.

sklauncher.label: SKlauncher
sklauncher.detail: Use this if you play through SKlauncher.

manual.label: Manual setup
manual.detail: Use this if your launcher is different.

lowEnd.label: Low power
lowEnd.detail: For older laptops or weak graphics.

shaders.label: Shaders
shaders.detail: For stronger PCs that can handle nicer lighting.

dynamic.light: Uses fewer extras for slower computers.
dynamic.standard: A good choice for most computers.
dynamic.shaders: Includes extra visual effects for stronger computers.

server.title: Choose a server.
server.lead: Enter the server address. The app gets the setup list from that server and shows what it wants to add or update.
server.help: Use the address players type in Minecraft. The app looks for the setup list from there.
server.codeHelp: Only enter this if Minecraft showed you a setup code when you tried to join.
server.emptySaved: Saved servers will appear here after you add one.

launcher.title: Choose your launcher.
launcher.lead: Pick the app you use to open Minecraft. This version works with the normal Minecraft Launcher.
launcher.notSupported: Support for this launcher is coming later.

profile.title: Choose how Minecraft should run.
profile.lead: Pick the option that matches your computer. The setup file saves the right mod list either way.
profile.missingSelection: Choose a setup option before continuing.

install.title: Review the setup steps.
install.lead: This checks Fabric, creates the clean game folder, and adds a launcher profile.
install.emptyLog: [waiting] Ready to create the local setup.

unsupported.label: This setup needs a newer app
unsupported.detail: Some requested steps are not available yet. Nothing will be changed until every step can be completed safely.

resourceSource.direct: From {{host}}. Checked with {{hash}} before it is used.
resourceSource.modrinth: From Modrinth project {{project}}, version {{version}}. The download is checked before it is used.

verify_loader.label: Check Minecraft version
verify_loader.detail: Make sure the right loader is available.

install_loader.label: Install Fabric
install_loader.detail: Add Fabric if this server needs it.

ensure_launcher_profile.label: Add the launcher profile
ensure_launcher_profile.detail: Create or update {{subject}} in your launcher.

write_setup_receipt.label: Save the setup record
write_setup_receipt.detail: Remember this setup so updates can be checked later.

validate_setup.label: Check everything
validate_setup.detail: Check the local files and launcher profile.

diagnostics.title: Check the setup.
diagnostics.lead: These checks look at the local setup files.

manifest.label: Setup list loaded
manifest.detail: Minecraft, Fabric, server, and mod choices are ready.

loader_version.label: Minecraft version
loader_version.detail: The Minecraft version and loader are installed.

managed_resources.label: Setup files
managed_resources.detail: The requested files match their expected versions.

server_entry.label: Saved server
server_entry.detail: The server is in Minecraft's server list.

setup_attestation.label: Server check-in
setup_attestation.detail: The server knows this setup is ready.
setup_attestation.failed: The local setup is ready, but the server did not accept the code: {{message}}

done.title: Local setup is ready.
done.lead: The clean game folder and setup file are ready on this computer.
